title: Space Force people ask about Hawkeye 360 detecting UAP signals at SCU

tellings.quote: went there in 2022 and people associated with space force from three-letter agencies came off to me and talk to me about applying Hawkeye abilities to just looking for UAP signals on the ground

plain: In 2022 in Huntsville, Alabama, at a meeting of the Scientific Coalition for UAP Studies, a group that researches unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAP, the newer word for UFOs), people tied to the Space Force and to intelligence agencies approached Bob Maguire, a former CIA contractor, he says. He tells Michels they talked to him "about applying Hawkeye abilities to just looking for UAP signals on the ground," meaning the signal-detecting abilities of a company called Hawkeye 360. If true, it would show official interest in hunting for UAP signals.
